#!/bin/bash
# Differential harness: run the C++ reference and the Rust port on identical
# argument vectors and report any byte-level divergence.
#
# Usage:
#   diff_test.sh <file-of-words>     # each line becomes one word, placed in all 4 slots
#   diff_test.sh --argv <file>       # each line is a TAB-separated argv list
CPP=${CPP:-/workspace/dataset/test12_executable}

fail=0
total=0

run_case() {
  total=$((total + 1))
  local expected actual
  expected=$("$CPP" "$@" 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s' "$?")
  actual=$("$RUST" "$@" 2>&1; printf 'rc=%s' "$?")
  if [ "$expected" != "$actual" ]; then
    fail=$((fail + 1))
    printf 'MISMATCH argv=['
    printf '%q ' "$@"
    printf ']\n'
    printf '  cpp : %s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$expected" | od -c | head -8)"
    printf '  rust: %s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$actual" | od -c | head -8)"
  fi
}

mode=words
if [ "$1" = "--argv" ]; then mode=argv; shift; fi

if [ "$mode" = argv ]; then
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r -a fields; do
    run_case "${fields[@]}"
  done < "$1"
else
  while IFS= read -r word; do
    run_case "$word" "$word" "$word" "$word"
    run_case "$word"
    run_case "$word" "$word"
    run_case "$word" "$word" "$word"
  done < "$1"
fi

printf '%s cases, %s mismatches\n' "$total" "$fail"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]
